items.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022
items.q: I’ll usually hire somebody like David Rothenberg or Richard Teitelbaum who plays synthesizer or laptop electronics and tell them what kinds of sounds I want

ctx.x: Did you ever take a dab into electronic instruments?

It’s interesting, you’re asking all these questions of things I’ve just been like thinking and talking about with people. I’ve always been attracted to electronics, more to pure sound design kind of things as opposed to samples of instruments and stuff like that. I have never worked with it because I never had a lot of confidence in myself as far as technology went, which I guess is one of my flaws. So if I hear certain types of sounds I’ll usually just hire somebody like David Rothenberg or Richard Teitelbaum…
I’m trying to think if it was an album you did, apparently some of the album had two pianos that were not in tune on purpose.
